## Change and purpose

Describe the problem or question and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue
if there is one.

## Validation

List the relevant commands/checks and their results, including any skipped tests.
For scientific changes, describe the dataset, units, athlete-grouping safeguards,
and whether the analysis specification or displayed evaluation results changed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests and documentation cover meaningful behavior changes.
- [ ] Source provenance, missingness, and train-only preprocessing are preserved.
- [ ] Claims distinguish retrospective association, joint loading, and injury.
- [ ] New data/media have appropriate permission, attribution, and license notices.
- [ ] No secrets, private credentials, or identifiable athlete material are included.

Mark inapplicable items with a short explanation. If an analysis was selected
after reviewing current results, say so explicitly.
